# Suzanne Webb

Suzanne Webb has participated in 1 election since 2002:

- [**2022 Deputies Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/suzanne-webb#e48)

  Not elected.

  - [2022 Vote.je Manifesto](https://www.vote.je/candidates/2022/suzanne-webb/)
  - [2022 Vote.je Video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=APzthLc5TpE)

Suzanne Webb has declared her intention to stand in the upcoming [2026 Connétables Election](https://flow.je/elections/2026) in [St Saviour](https://flow.je/elections/st-saviour). \[[jerseyeveningpost.com](https://jerseyeveningpost.com/news/2026/03/13/former-teacher-confirms-st-saviour-constable-bid/)\]
